+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The mono kernels of the decoder layers and of the MTP prologue: vLLM tensors
+-> launches. A ``MonoLayer`` runs one whole decoder layer (GatedDeltaNet or full
+attention, then the MoE with the shared expert, both TP all-reduces in the
+kernel) on a planned step; ``MtpPrologue`` runs the MTP drafter's two pre-fc
+norms and fc. The kernels read vLLM's loaded weights and caches in place;
+``bind`` registers them with the kernels (again whenever the caches move)."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+
+def _kv(attn) -> torch.Tensor:
+    kv = attn.kv_cache
+    return kv[0] if isinstance(kv, (list, tuple)) else kv
+
+
+class MonoLayer:
+    """One decoder layer. ``kid``: its kernel-side id (the scratch and mailbox
+    tag slot); ``name``: its mailbox."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: nn.Module, kid: int, name: str):
+        self.layer, self.kid, self.name = layer, kid, name
+        self.attn = layer.layer_type == "full_attention"
+        # the key of this layer's metadata in the forward context
+        self.prefix = (
+            layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name if self.attn else layer.linear_attn.prefix
+        )
+
+    def caches(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        if self.attn:
+            return [_kv(self.layer.self_attn.attn)]
+        state = self.layer.linear_attn.kv_cache
+        return [state[0], state[1]]
+
+    def weights(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """The kernel's tensor list: norms, router, shared gate, the mixer's
+        output projection, routed and shared experts, then the mixer."""
+        layer, mlp = self.layer, self.layer.mlp
+        experts = getattr(mlp.experts, "routed_experts", mlp.experts)
+        mixer = layer.self_attn if self.attn else layer.linear_attn
+        out = mixer.o_proj if self.attn else mixer.out_proj
+        t = [
+            layer.input_layernorm.weight,
+            layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+            mlp.gate.weight,
+            mlp.shared_expert_gate.weight,
+            out.weight,
+            out.weight_scale,
+            experts.w13_weight,
+            experts.w13_weight_scale,
+            experts.w2_weight,
+            experts.w2_weight_scale,
+            mlp.shared_expert.gate_up_proj.weight,
+            mlp.shared_expert.gate_up_proj.weight_scale,
+            mlp.shared_expert.down_proj.weight,
+            mlp.shared_expert.down_proj.weight_scale,
+        ]
+        if self.attn:
+            return t + [
+                mixer.qkv_proj.weight,
+                mixer.qkv_proj.weight_scale,
+                mixer.q_norm.weight,
+                mixer.k_norm.weight,
+            ]
+        return t + [
+            mixer.in_proj_qkvz.weight,
+            mixer.in_proj_qkvz.weight_scale,
+            mixer.in_proj_ba.weight,
+            mixer.in_proj_ba.weight_scale,
+            mixer.conv1d.weight,
+            mixer.A_log,
+            mixer.dt_bias,
+            mixer.norm.weight,
+        ]
+
+    def bind(self, mailbox: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
+        """Registers the weights and the current caches (the kernel checks every
+        shape, dtype and stride and raises on a mismatch). Registering a layer
+        again only updates its pointers."""
+        own, peer = mailbox
+        torch.ops._xpu_C.mono_register_layer(
+            self.kid, self.attn, own, peer, self.weights() + self.caches()
+        )
+
+    def _metadata(self, md, verify: bool):
+        m = md[self.prefix]
+        if self.attn:
+            return m.block_table, m.seq_lens, m.slot_mapping
+        if verify:
+            return m.spec_state_indices_tensor, m.num_accepted_tokens, None
+        return m.non_spec_state_indices_tensor, None, None
+
+    def launch(
+        self,
+        q: int,
+        md,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The layer's (hidden_states, residual) out, like the stock layer's
+        forward: ``q`` 1 is a decode step, else a verify step of q tokens a
+        request (the plan checked the metadata and the width)."""
+        if residual is None:
+            # layer 0: the stock layer takes the input as the residual
+            residual = torch.zeros_like(hidden_states)
+        out = torch.empty_like(hidden_states)
+        res = torch.empty_like(hidden_states)
+        m0, m1, m2 = self._metadata(md, q > 1)
+        ops = torch.ops._xpu_C
+        if q > 1:
+            served = ops.mono_decode_layer_spec(
+                self.kid, q, hidden_states, residual, out, res, positions, m0, m1, m2
+            )
+            # the plan only picks widths the verify kernels have
+            assert served, f"no verify kernel for {hidden_states.shape[0]} rows x {q}"
+        else:
+            ops.mono_decode_layer(
+                self.kid, hidden_states, residual, out, res, positions, m0, m1, m2
+            )
+        return out, res
+
+
+class MtpPrologue:
+    """fc([norm_e(e); norm_h(h)]) of the MTP predictor on [e; h], one kernel
+    for 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 8 rows."""
+
+    def __init__(self, predictor: nn.Module, kid: int, name: str):
+        self.kid, self.name = kid, name
+        self.norm_e = predictor.pre_fc_norm_embedding
+        self.norm_h = predictor.pre_fc_norm_hidden
+        self.fc = predictor.fc
+
+    def weights(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        return [
+            self.norm_e.weight,
+            self.norm_h.weight,
+            self.fc.weight,
+            self.fc.weight_scale,
+        ]
+
+    def bind(self, mailbox: tuple[int, int], rank: int) -> None:
+        own, peer = mailbox
+        torch.ops._xpu_C.mono_register_mtp(self.kid, own, peer, self.weights(), rank)
+
+    def launch(self, embeds: torch.Tensor, hidden: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = torch.cat([embeds, hidden], dim=-1)
+        out = x.new_empty(x.shape[0], hidden.shape[-1])
+        served = torch.ops._xpu_C.mono_mtp_prologue(self.kid, x, out)
+        assert served, f"no MTP prologue kernel for {x.shape[0]} rows"
+        return out

+"""The P2P mailboxes of the in-kernel TP all-reduces: one device region per
+rank, exported with Level Zero IPC and imported by the peer, holding one mailbox
+per mono layer / MTP prologue and the vocabulary-shard candidate exchange; and
+the TP agreements that must precede anything collective."""
+
+import os
+import socket
+import tempfile
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """True when every rank of ``group`` passed ``ok`` true. Every rank must call
+    it at the same point; ``group`` is a CPU (gloo) process group."""
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def _exchange_fd(fd: int, rank: int, group) -> int:
+    """Swaps the dma-buf fds of the two ranks over a unix socket (SCM_RIGHTS):
+    importing the peer's IPC handle needs no ptrace permission this way."""
+    paths: list = [None] * dist.get_world_size(group)
+    path = srv = None
+    if rank == 0:
+        path = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), f"vllm_xpu_mono_{os.getpid()}.sock")
+        if os.path.exists(path):
+            os.unlink(path)
+        srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+        srv.bind(path)
+        srv.listen(1)
+    dist.all_gather_object(paths, path, group=group)
+    if srv is not None:
+        conn, _ = srv.accept()
+    else:
+        conn = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+        conn.connect(paths[0])
+    with conn:
+        socket.send_fds(conn, [b"f"], [fd])
+        _, fds, _, _ = socket.recv_fds(conn, 1, 1)
+    if srv is not None:
+        assert path is not None
+        srv.close()
+        os.unlink(path)
+    return fds[0]
+
+
+class PeerRegion:
+    """This rank's region and the peer's, mapped: one mailbox per name, then the
+    candidate exchange. The constructor is collective over the TP CPU group (the
+    handle and fd exchange): every rank reaches it after the TP agreements."""
+
+    def __init__(self, names: list[str], rank: int, group):
+        ops = torch.ops._xpu_C
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.mbox_bytes = int(ops.mono_mbox_bytes())
+        self.slots = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(names)}
+        self.lm_off = len(names) * self.mbox_bytes
+        self.handle = ops.mono_ipc_create(
+            self.lm_off + int(ops.mono_lmhead_mbox_bytes())
+        )
+        info = ops.mono_ipc_export(self.handle)
+        infos: list = [None] * dist.get_world_size(group)
+        dist.all_gather_object(infos, info, group=group)
+        peer_fd = _exchange_fd(int(info[1]), rank, group)
+        mode = ops.mono_ipc_open(self.handle, infos[1 - rank], peer_fd)
+        self.own = int(ops.mono_ipc_ptr(self.handle, False))
+        self.peer = int(ops.mono_ipc_ptr(self.handle, True))
+        logger.info(
+            "Qwen3.5 XPU mono decode: P2P mailboxes for %d kernels (IPC import "
+            "mode %d)",
+            len(names),
+            mode,
+        )
+
+    def mailbox(self, name: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """(own, peer) addresses of the mailbox of ``name``."""
+        off = self.slots[name] * self.mbox_bytes
+        return self.own + off, self.peer + off
+
+    def candidates(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """(own, peer) addresses of the candidate exchange."""
+        return self.own + self.lm_off, self.peer + self.lm_off

+"""Candidate sampling: on a step whose sampling needs only the largest logits,
+each rank takes the k largest logits of its vocabulary shard and the ranks swap
+them (``_xpu_C.mono_shard_topk``) instead of all-gathering the logits; vLLM's
+sampler and rejection sampler then run on the [rows, w] candidates, and the
+sampled candidate positions are mapped back to token ids.
+
+The candidates hold every request's top-k (k = 1 for greedy requests), so the
+result has the stock distribution: greedy picks the same token, top-k / top-p
+sampling draws from the same k tokens with the same probabilities. A step
+takes the candidates only if every request in it is greedy or samples with a
+top_k within the kernel's limit, and none needs anything over the whole
+vocabulary: logprobs, penalties, logit bias, bad words, allowed tokens,
+min_tokens, min_p, a thinking budget, structured output, an explicit seed
+(its draw would differ from the stock one), custom logits processors,
+probabilistic drafts. Every other step all-gathers the logits."""
+
+from typing import cast
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.input_batch import get_num_sampled_and_rejected
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.output import SamplerOutput
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler import Sampler
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.rejection_sampler import (
+    RejectionSampler,
+    gather_draft_sampled,
+    get_max_chunk_logits,
+)
+
+# rows of the candidate exchange (a decode or verify step of the kernels)
+MAX_ROWS = 8
+# the narrowest candidate row: vLLM's top-k / top-p kernels run on >= 128
+# columns
+MIN_WIDTH = 128
+
+
+def _request_ok(sp, k_max: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether a request's sampling needs only its top-k (top_k <= k_max) or
+    its argmax."""
+    if (
+        sp.logprobs is not None
+        or sp.presence_penalty != 0.0
+        or sp.frequency_penalty != 0.0
+        or sp.repetition_penalty != 1.0
+        or sp.logit_bias
+        or sp.bad_words
+        or sp.allowed_token_ids
+        or sp.min_tokens
+        or sp.min_p != 0.0
+        or sp.thinking_token_budget is not None
+        or sp.structured_outputs is not None
+    ):
+        return False
+    if sp.temperature == 0.0:
+        return True
+    return sp.seed is None and 1 <= sp.top_k <= k_max
+
+
+class Candidates:
+    """The per-step decision and the exchange. ``plan`` (host values only, the
+    same on every rank) runs in ``compute_sample_logits`` with the batch
+    ``ModelState.prepare_inputs`` saw; the samplers read ``idx`` (the
+    candidates' token ids) of the step that produced candidates."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, region, rank: int, max_num_reqs: int):
+        self.region, self.rank = region, rank
+        self.k_max = int(torch.ops._xpu_C.mono_shard_topk_max_k())
+        self.ok = np.zeros(max_num_reqs, dtype=bool)
+        self.k = np.zeros(max_num_reqs, dtype=np.int32)  # 1 for greedy
+        self.batch = None  # this step's input batch (prepare_inputs)
+        self.idx: torch.Tensor | None = None  # [rows, w] token ids, or None
+        spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        mc = vllm_config.model_config
+        self.enabled = (
+            self.k_max > 0
+            and not mc.logits_processors
+            and vllm_config.watermark_config is None
+            and not mc.return_sampling_mask
+            and not mc.enable_trace_replay
+            and (
+                spec is None
+                or (
+                    spec.draft_sample_method == "greedy"
+                    and spec.rejection_sample_method == "standard"
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
+    def add_request(self, req_idx: int, sampling_params) -> None:
+        ok = _request_ok(sampling_params, self.k_max)
+        self.ok[req_idx] = ok
+        greedy = sampling_params.temperature == 0.0
+        self.k[req_idx] = 1 if greedy else (sampling_params.top_k if ok else 0)
+
+    def plan(self, rows: int) -> int | None:
+        """K for this step's candidates, or None for the all-gathered logits."""
+        batch, self.batch, self.idx = self.batch, None, None
+        if not self.enabled or batch is None or not 1 <= rows <= MAX_ROWS:
+            return None
+        if batch.has_structured_output_reqs:
+            return None
+        reqs = batch.idx_mapping_np
+        if not np.all(self.ok[reqs]):
+            return None
+        return int(np.max(self.k[reqs]))
+
+    def logits(self, shard: torch.Tensor, k: int, verify: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """[rows, w] fp32 candidate logits (-inf padding) from this rank's
+        [rows, vocab / 2] logits shard; ``idx`` gets their token ids. A verify
+        step gets one more -inf column, the position of a draft token that is
+        not a candidate (target probability 0)."""
+        rows = shard.shape[0]
+        width = max(2 * k, MIN_WIDTH)
+        vals = torch.empty(rows, width, dtype=torch.float32, device=shard.device)
+        idx = torch.empty(rows, width, dtype=torch.int32, device=shard.device)
+        own, peer = self.region.candidates()
+        torch.ops._xpu_C.mono_shard_topk(
+            vals, idx, shard.contiguous(), k, self.rank, own, peer
+        )
+        if verify:
+            vals = F.pad(vals, (0, 1), value=float("-inf"))
+            idx = F.pad(idx, (0, 1), value=-1)
+        self.idx = idx.to(torch.int64)
+        return vals
+
+    def take(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """The candidates' token ids if ``logits`` are this step's candidates
+        (the dummy sampler runs compute their logits elsewhere), once."""
+        idx, self.idx = self.idx, None
+        if idx is None or idx.shape != logits.shape:
+            return None
+        return idx
+
+
+def draft_positions(idx: torch.Tensor, draft_sampled: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Draft token ids -> candidate positions. The draft in row j is verified
+    by the logits of row j - 1 (a request's first row holds no draft), so it is
+    looked up in that row's candidates; a draft that is not a candidate gets the
+    last, -inf column, a placeholder (-1) stays -1."""
+    miss = idx.shape[1] - 1
+    prev = torch.cat([idx[:1], idx[:-1]])
+    hit = prev == draft_sampled.unsqueeze(1)
+    pos = torch.where(hit.any(dim=1), hit.int().argmax(dim=1), miss)
+    return torch.where(draft_sampled < 0, -1, pos).to(draft_sampled.dtype)
+
+
+class CandidateSampler:
+    """vLLM's sampler, on the candidates of a candidate step."""
+
+    def __init__(self, sampler, candidates: Candidates):
+        self.sampler, self.candidates = sampler, candidates
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        return getattr(self.sampler, name)
+
+    def add_request(self, req_idx: int, sampling_params) -> None:
+        self.sampler.add_request(req_idx, sampling_params)
+        self.candidates.add_request(req_idx, sampling_params)
+
+    def __call__(self, logits: torch.Tensor, input_batch) -> SamplerOutput:
+        idx = self.candidates.take(logits)
+        out = self.sampler(logits, input_batch)
+        if idx is not None:  # candidate positions -> token ids
+            st = out.sampled_token_ids
+            out.sampled_token_ids = idx.gather(1, st.to(torch.int64)).to(st.dtype)
+        return out
+
+
+class CandidateRejectionSampler(RejectionSampler):
+    """vLLM's rejection sampler, on the candidates of a candidate verify step:
+    the draft tokens are mapped to candidate positions (the extra -inf column
+    when a draft is not a candidate), the verified positions back to token
+    ids."""
+
+    def __init__(self, sampler: CandidateSampler, spec_config, device):
+        super().__init__(cast(Sampler, sampler), spec_config, device)
+        self.candidates = sampler.candidates
+
+    def __call__(self, logits, input_batch, draft_logits=None) -> SamplerOutput:
+        idx = self.candidates.take(logits)
+        if idx is None:
+            return super().__call__(logits, input_batch, draft_logits)
+        assert draft_logits is None
+        draft_sampled, pos = gather_draft_sampled(
+            input_batch.input_ids,
+            input_batch.positions,
+            input_batch.logits_indices,
+            input_batch.expanded_idx_mapping,
+            input_batch.expanded_local_pos,
+            self.sampler.req_states.prefill_len.gpu,
+        )
+        sampled, num_sampled, _, _ = self._verify_in_chunks(
+            logits,
+            input_batch,

+        or runner.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0
+        or runner.routed_experts.apply_router_weight_on_input

+        or config.is_lora_enabled
+        or parallel.enable_eplb
+        or parallel.use_ep
+        or parallel.ep_size != 1
+        or runner.expert_map is not None
+        or parallel.dp_size != 1
+        or parallel.pcp_size != 1
+        or parallel.is_sequence_parallel

+        runner.routed_experts.w13_weight,
+        runner.routed_experts.w2_weight,
+        gu.weight,
+        down.weight,
+        runner.routed_experts.w13_weight_scale,
+        runner.routed_experts.w2_weight_scale,

+        and shared_s13.numel() == shared_s2.numel() == 1
+        and gate_weight.dtype == runner.moe_config.in_dtype
+        and shared_w13.shape == w13.shape[1:]
+        and shared_w2.shape == w2.shape[1:]
+        and w2.shape[0] == w13.shape[0]
+        and w13.shape[2] == 2 * w2.shape[1]
+        and w2.shape[2] == w13.shape[1]

+        and gate_weight.shape in ((w13.shape[1],), (1, w13.shape[1]))
+    ):

+    matrices = (w13, w2, shared_w13, shared_w2)

+    ):
+        return None

+@torch.no_grad()
+def prepare_weights(block: "Qwen3_5SparseMoeBlock") -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+    """Use model-owned contiguous parameters, preserved by in-place reload."""
+    if get_weights(block) is None:
+        return None
+    shared = block.shared_expert
+    assert shared is not None
+    routed = block.experts.routed_experts
+    for layer, names in (
+        (routed, ("w13_weight", "w2_weight", "w13_weight_scale", "w2_weight_scale")),
+        (shared.gate_up_proj, ("weight", "weight_scale")),
+        (shared.down_proj, ("weight", "weight_scale")),
+        (block.shared_expert_gate, ("weight",)),
+    ):
+        for name in names:
+            parameter = getattr(layer, name)
+            if not parameter.is_contiguous():
+                replace_parameter(layer, name, parameter.contiguous())
+    return get_weights(block)
